issues.reason: Coordination & plurals requires a plural referred to as a unit to take (GroupOf <group> <kind>), and warns that a bare Member on the collection says the group-as-object IS one of that kind, so (Member sk_ground_feather_1 ground_feather) asserts a single feather where the text describes a handful of many -- and the plural/count noun is exactly the cue the Partitives section gives for the GroupOf route rather than the mass Member+PartOf one.

gaps_confirmed: measure-partitive quantity NP ('one handful of ground feathers', the instruction set's own excluded example 'a cup of water'): explicitly barred from the genitive of-phrase routes but given no positive encoding, and 'a handful' appears only as a vague-count CardinalityPhrase, never as a counted measure unit
new_gaps: a participial preparation modifier ('ground feathers', 'dried herbs', 'powdered bark') sits between the fuse test's two poles -- it is neither a listed fusing classifier (term of art, nationality, role title, material adjective) nor plainly incidental description like the two-atom 'laminated worktop' -- so whether it fuses, and whether the participle is then exposable as a modifier genus, is undecided
defect_summary: The compliant form gives the plural a group witness -- (GroupOf sk_group_1 ground_feather) -- and hangs the quantity atom and the protect event's Agent on that group symbol; the 'one handful of' quantity itself still has no licensed carrier, since CardinalityPhrase records a vague word rather than a stated count of measure units, so that half remains a gap.
notes: The duration is right (Measure ... duration with (ParticleFromNormal 1 0.1) for the tight hedge 'about'), as are Agent on the inanimate transitive subject, Theme for the unaltered lantern, the reserved unspecified scale symbol, and the absence of a tense atom on the generic present.
